svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Introduction to Kubernetes, slide 1 of 12: What we'll build
svg.desc: What we'll build: visitors reach k8s.gulfheight.com through a Google Cloud load balancer with the static IP bugsquash-ip, made by the Ingress bugsquash; inside a GKE regional cluster in europe-central2 the Services lead to three zones a, b and c, each with one e2-medium node running a frontend and a backend pod, and zone a also runs postgres with its 5Gi disk; a control plane run by Google, replicated in 3 zones, takes kubectl commands from your laptop; the ConfigMap bugsquash-config, the Secret bugsquash-secrets and the claim postgres-data live in the cluster too.
svg.text: Bug Squash Arena on Google Kubernetes Engine: one address, three zones, copies everywhere.
static IP bugsquash-ip · made by the Ingress
